response.text:
I can’t add the event or say “it is done” — there are no calendar tools available here, and creating calendar events is an external action that I can’t perform without access/confirmation. I can, however, prepare the event details and give you copy/paste text or an importable .ics if you want.

Quick facts / clarifying questions before I prepare the event for you:
- Date: Today is Mon 2028-08-21 (America/Los_Angeles). “Next Wednesday” would be Wed, 2028-08-23. Is that what you mean?
- Time: you said “2” — do you mean 2:00 PM or 2:00 AM (I assume 2:00 PM)?
- Duration: unspecified — common choices: 30 min, 45 min, 60 min. Which do you prefer? (I recommend 60 min for dental appointments.)
- Location: unspecified — do you want a placeholder like “Dentist office” or the full address?
- Target calendar: which calendar should this go on (e.g., Personal / Work / [calendar name])?
- Reminders: do you want a reminder (e.g., 1 day before, 1 hour before)?

Suggested default event (please confirm or edit):
- Title: Dentist appointment
- Date: Wed, Aug 23, 2028
- Time: 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM PDT (America/Los_Angeles)
- Location: [Dentist office]
- Calendar: [Your primary calendar]
- Reminder: 1 day before and 1 hour before
- Description: Dental cleaning/check-up. Add contact info or notes here.

What I can do next (pick one):
1) Generate a ready-to-paste event description and suggested reminders you can copy into your calendar.
2) Create an .ics file text you can import into most calendar apps (I’ll provide the file contents so you can save/import).
3) Draft an email or message to the dentist with the appointment details.
4) Nothing else — you’ll add it manually.

Tell me which options you want and confirm the date/time/duration/location/calendar (or say “use the suggested defaults”), and I’ll produce the event text or .ics for you.
